title: SignConnect recognition.control v1
description: Strict browser-to-realtime lifecycle event. Start initializes and stop releases one recognition stream; no media data is permitted.

timestampMs.description: A finite, non-negative monotonic timestamp in milliseconds. Standard JSON forbids NaN and infinity; consumers also reject non-increasing timestamps.

action.description: Start explicitly initializes a fresh stream; stop explicitly releases it.

sequence.description: A non-negative sequence number. Producers increment it monotonically; consumers reject regressions or gaps where the protocol requires continuity.
